title: CEB methodology and source notes

officialNotes.text: The revenue and expenses amounts reflect data as reported by organizations in their respective financial statements, without adjustments for revenue and/or expenses associated with transfers of funding between UN organizations.

Data and charts are updated annually, on conclusion of individual management survey reporting cycles, figures are quality assured and validated with the organizations’ audited financial statements wherever possible.

The data presented include additional six entities (CTBTO, ICC, UNCDF, UNFCCC, UNRISD, UNSSC) from 2017, three more entities (OPCW, UNITAID, IARC) from 2018, from 2019, (ITLOS) and two more from 2021 (UNCCD, ISA).
2023 revenue by contributor data does not include contributions to IRMCT.
ITC did not submit data for 2025.

transformations.title: Names and grouping
transformations.text: We standardize contributor and organization names and use readable labels for organization codes. Geographic records are grouped for display using UN M49 regions, with reviewed corrections to location names and reporting levels.

transformations.title: Revenue and contributors
transformations.text: We combine reported revenue totals with the available contributor and financing breakdowns. Differences between a total and its identified contributors appear as Other within a known contributor category, or Unattributed. These calculated balances can be positive or negative. Historical financing instruments not matched to the four main categories are grouped under Other financing instruments.

transformations.title: Expenditure
transformations.text: We use reported organization totals and their geographic, function and SDG breakdowns. SDG figures include expenditure reported on accrual and budgetary accounting bases. Non-SDG is a reported category; Not specified is the calculated difference between total expenditure and the reported SDG and Non-SDG amounts. Functions retain the earlier classification before the change in 2018.

transformations.title: Charts
transformations.text: Negative amounts remain in totals and details; treemap areas show positive amounts. Flow diagrams place each organization’s contributor breakdown alongside its expenditure breakdowns.

introduction: The UN System pages use CEB Financial Statistics, compiled from financial information reported by UN organizations. We use the latest release, including revisions to earlier years. Amounts are in US dollars at the prices of the year reported.
readingNotes: CEB totals include transfers between UN organizations, so combined amounts can count the same funding more than once. Reporting coverage and source revisions affect comparisons over time. Missing observations and blank amounts remain unavailable.
